annotations.title: Search companies by industry, country, size and signals

description: REAL COMPANIES FOR A PROSPECT LIST, each with its own website, country, a size hint, what its site says it does, the ad pixels and platforms its homepage carries (Meta Pixel, Google Ads, TikTok Pixel, Shopify …) and its signals (hiring, new ads on Meta or LinkedIn, funding). Give it description (the kind of company, in plain words) and/or industry, country, size, uses (tags its site must carry) and keywords, or signals [{ type, query }] of the company types: hiring, new_ads_meta, new_ads_linkedin, funding, web. It runs on demand over public lookups (ad libraries, job boards, news, web search) and reads each company's own site; only companies whose website was found come back, sorted by fit, marked when already in the brand's email leads or do-not-email list. Nothing is stored. PAID like find_leads: about 1 credit per lookup under a hard maxCredits (default 10); reading the websites is free; dryRun:true prices it. SaveAs keeps it for saved_lead_searches. Works with nothing connected.

country.description: 2-letter country; a company whose own site places it elsewhere is left out

days.description: how recent a signal must be, 1 to 90 (default 30)

description.description: the kind of company ("paid social agencies for e-commerce brands")

dryRun.description: true = the price and the plan only

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

id.description: a company id from that search, such as L3

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

industry.description: any words ("marketing agency", "dental clinic"); a company whose own site does not read as it is left out

keywords.description: words their ads or homepages use (up to 5)

saveAs.description: a name: keep this search for saved_lead_searches

searchId.description: with id: one company of an earlier search in full (free)

size.description: staff range ("2-50", "200+") or small / mid-size / enterprise; a company whose site says otherwise is left out

uses.description: tags its homepage must carry: meta_pixel, google_ads, tiktok_pixel, linkedin_insight, pinterest_tag, snap_pixel, reddit_pixel, x_pixel, microsoft_uet, google_analytics, shopify, woocommerce, wordpress, webflow, wix, squarespace, hubspot, klaviyo, intercom, stripe, app_store, google_play
